catalogTerms.english: He left the Arena before it got too hot.
catalogTerms.japanese: 熱くなりすぎる前に闘技場を後にした。

catalogTerms.english: He fought desperately in the Arena but didn't have what it takes.
catalogTerms.japanese: 闘技場で必死に戦ったが、実力が足りなかった。

catalogTerms.english: He left the Arena as a champion!
catalogTerms.japanese: 王者として闘技場を後にした！

catalogTerms.english: He decided to nuke Hell's production center.
catalogTerms.japanese: 地獄の生産施設を核爆弾で破壊することにした。

catalogTerms.english: He left the Armory without drawing too much attention.
catalogTerms.japanese: あまり注意を引かずに武器庫を後にした。

catalogTerms.english: He fled being chased by a nightmare!
catalogTerms.japanese: 悪夢に追われながら逃げ出した！

catalogTerms.english: He destroyed the evil within and reaped the rewards!
catalogTerms.japanese: 中に潜む邪悪を滅ぼし、報酬を手に入れた！

catalogTerms.english: He arrived at the Phobos Anomaly.
catalogTerms.japanese: フォボス異常地帯へ到着した。

catalogTerms.english: He found the Tower of Babel.
catalogTerms.japanese: バベルの塔を見つけた。

catalogTerms.english: Then at last he found Dis!
catalogTerms.japanese: そしてついに、ディスを見つけた！

catalogTerms.english: He defeated the Mastermind and found the TRUE EVIL!
catalogTerms.japanese: マスターマインドを倒し、真の邪悪を見つけた！
行く手を阻むものは何もなかった。

catalogTerms.english: He couldn't quite finish the job.
catalogTerms.japanese: 仕事を最後までやり遂げられなかった。

catalogTerms.english: He defeated the Hell Arena Master!
catalogTerms.japanese: 地獄の闘技場の主を倒した！

catalogTerms.english: Not knowing what to do, he left.
catalogTerms.japanese: どうすればよいかわからず、立ち去った。

catalogTerms.english: He broke into the Containment Area, but gave up against the overwhelming forces.
catalogTerms.japanese: 封鎖区域へ突入したが、圧倒的な戦力を前に諦めた。

catalogTerms.english: He emerged from the Containment Area victorious!
catalogTerms.japanese: 封鎖区域で勝利を収めた！

catalogTerms.english: He decided to nuke the forbidden Lab.
catalogTerms.japanese: 禁断の研究所を核爆弾で破壊することにした。

catalogTerms.english: He left the Deimos Lab without drawing too much attention.
catalogTerms.japanese: あまり注意を引かずにダイモス研究所を後にした。

catalogTerms.english: He fought hard, but decided the reward was not worth it.
catalogTerms.japanese: 奮戦したが、報酬に見合わないと判断した。

catalogTerms.english: He fled the lab after unleashing a nightmare!
catalogTerms.japanese: 悪夢を解き放った後、研究所から逃げ出した！

catalogTerms.english: He fled the Unholy Cathedral seeing no chance to win.
catalogTerms.japanese: 勝ち目がないと悟り、邪悪の大聖堂から逃げ出した。

catalogTerms.english: He then destroyed the Unholy Cathedral!
catalogTerms.japanese: そして邪悪の大聖堂を破壊した！

catalogTerms.english: He left the House without drawing too much attention.
catalogTerms.japanese: あまり注意を引かずに苦痛の館を後にした。

catalogTerms.english: He fled the House on fire!
catalogTerms.japanese: 炎上する苦痛の館から逃げ出した！

catalogTerms.english: He started his journey on the surface of Phobos.
catalogTerms.japanese: フォボスの地表から旅を始めた。

catalogTerms.english: He decided it was too hot there.
catalogTerms.japanese: そこは熱すぎると判断した。

catalogTerms.english: He fled there from the monstrous lava elemental.
catalogTerms.japanese: 巨大な溶岩のエレメンタルから逃げ出した。

catalogTerms.english: He managed to clear the Lava Pits completely!
catalogTerms.japanese: 溶岩の穴を完全に制圧した！

catalogTerms.english: He managed to clear Limbo from evil!
catalogTerms.japanese: リンボの邪悪を一掃した！

catalogTerms.english: He managed to escape from Limbo!

catalogTerms.japanese: 騒ぎを起こさずに立ち去った。
かつての仲間たちを浄化した。

catalogTerms.english: He managed to clear the Mortuary from evil!
catalogTerms.japanese: 死体安置所の邪悪を一掃した！

catalogTerms.english: He managed to escape from the Mortuary!

catalogTerms.english: He decided it was too dangerous.

catalogTerms.english: He managed to raise Mt. Erebus completely!

catalogTerms.english: He wiped out the City of Skulls.

catalogTerms.english: He fled the Lair, knowing how to fear Arachnotrons!
catalogTerms.japanese: アラクノトロンの恐ろしさを知り、蜘蛛の巣から逃げ出した！

catalogTerms.english: He cleared the Lair, kickin' serious spider ass!
catalogTerms.japanese: 蜘蛛どもを叩きのめし、巣を制圧した！

catalogTerms.english: He came, he saw, but he left.
catalogTerms.japanese: 来て、見て、しかし立ち去った。

catalogTerms.english: He managed to scavenge a part of the Vaults' treasures.

catalogTerms.english: He managed to clear the Vaults completely!
catalogTerms.japanese: 金庫室を完全に制圧した！

catalogTerms.english: He cracked the Vaults and cleared them out!

catalogTerms.english: He broke into the Wall, but gave up against the overwhelming forces.
catalogTerms.japanese: 壁の向こうへ突入したが、圧倒的な戦力を前に諦めた。

catalogTerms.english: He massacred the evil behind the Wall!
